subject: gk
question: Which part of the Indian Constitution deals with fundamental rights?
solution:
The correct answer is __Part III__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Part III:-

 
 
• Part III of the Constitution deals with Fundamental Rights.
 
• Fundamental Rights of citizens are obtained in Articles 12-35.
 
• The Constitution provides six Fundamental Rights for the citizens:
 
 
• Right to Equality
 
• Right to Freedom
 
• Right against exploitation
 
• Right to Freedom of Religion
 
• Cultural and Educational rights
 
• Right to constitutional Remedies
